metadata.program: SkyraSoft HBOS Public Distribution & Multi-Tenant Platform Integrity Program
metadata.evaluation_scope: Tens of Thousands of Independent Business Tenants

database_indexing.analysis: All major tables (sales, purchases, products, customers, accounts, movements, inventory) have composite indexes prefixed by business_id. Query execution plans will filter by tenant efficiently.

tenant_query_patterns.analysis: TenantScope guarantees where(business_id = active_business_id) on all reads. Zero unbounded cross-tenant queries.

api_statelessness.analysis: Laravel Sanctum tokens are stateless per request. Auth state is resolved from Bearer token and headers.

laravel_session_token_architecture.analysis: Sanctum personal_access_tokens table is indexed on tokenable_type and tokenable_id. High concurrency is supported.

file_storage.analysis: Local storage disk is fine for single-server; for multi-server cloud deployment, AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2 driver should be configured via config/filesystems.php.

queues_and_background_jobs.analysis: Database / Redis queue configuration ready. Async jobs for emails and ledger processing.

report_queries.analysis: Report queries aggregate within business_id and branch_id date ranges. Heavy date range queries on millions of rows should maintain created_at composite indexes.

sync_batch_sizes.analysis: Bulk sync transactions capped at 100 records per payload, preventing payload blowout.

rate_limits.analysis: Public auth routes must have throttle middleware applied (PLATFORM-GAP-003).

connection_pools_and_caching.analysis: Redis cache driver recommended for Spatie permission caching at scale (24h default cache is configured).

database_contention.analysis: Row-level locking used in POS sale transactions (DB::transaction with optimistic stock decrement). Since stock is isolated per branch/tenant, contention across different businesses is zero.
